snippet.title: Death by Taxes - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for our second game - Death By Taxes where you play as a billionaire who is allergic to paying taxes and need to spend all the money to now die from paying a single dollar in tax!

Steam page - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4696280/Death_by_Taxes/
